summary: Imjin River area, Korea, 1951-08-08. The two cars at left have just brought Australia's Minister for External Affairs, The Right Honourable Richard G. Casey, and his advisers to the camp occupied by the 3rd Battalion, The Royal Australian Regiment (3RAR). Casey is the balding figure in civilian clothes in the centre of the group standing next to the jeep. At right, members of 'A' Company assemble
